reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: § 7.6 grants the MFN in Customer's favour (Vendor warrants Fees to Customer will be no less favourable than those offered to similarly situated customers), which is the outcome the playbook welcomes.

No Customer-side MFN or best-terms/benchmarking obligation appears in the cited paragraphs; § 12.3 affirmatively confirms Customer made no most-favoured-customer commitment, corroborating the preferred position.

Correctly no redline and no counterparty comment, consistent with the rule's instruction to mark Vendor-granted MFN compliant and not redline; original and rendered text are identical, and no deterministic checks flag issues.
